properties.description: What a client of the MCP server sees once the Anchor node type is removed (0.86.0), with deprecation::REGISTRY as built, every call over the protocol: describe_schema lists 28 node types and no Anchor, lists no `deprecations`, and answers a question about Anchor as about any unknown type; neither tools/list nor describe_schema's whole answer says "removed in the next release", carries a DEPRECATED mark, or names `Anchor` as a word; create_node of an Anchor is refused naming the type and writes nothing; an export holding one is refused by import_graph naming it as retired with dec:anchor-retire-or-implement, all or nothing; DriftEvent's hint says it DEPENDS_ON the drifted Artifact and a recorded reconcile_artifacts draws exactly that.
properties.name: tests/the_unused_anchor_type_is_removed.rs
